root_cause: Once identity-proven Windsor LinkedIn company post impressions are reconciled into social_metric_snapshots with data_quality PROVIDER_OBSERVED_LINKED, the existing daily content-growth analyzer recognizes only OBSERVED/OBSERVED_PARTIAL_SCOPE/PROVIDER_OBSERVED and uses reach/views as exposure. It would discard verified provider impression counts and fail to measure the same canonical business post in the next-day learning artifact.

observed_evidence.provider_values: Observed 1,5,10,13 impressions; these are small samples not evidence of poor content.

fix: Extend the EXISTING daily Content growth learning diagnostic to accept independently linked company-post source quality and explicit impression denominators while preserving views/reach as unknown when absent. Require >=50 exposure per post before flagging no engagement, with explicit denominator type and no imaginary conversions.
prevention_rule: LinkedIn impressions, reach, video views and social reactions are different provider metrics; do not manufacture views from impressions or assume causality. Do not compare cohorts across denominator types, promote creative winners or change customer permissions based on five impressions.
terminal_rule: Protected exact-head Required+CodeQL and merge, next actual daily Content growth learning workflow provider readback with LINKED post metrics; 24/48/72h post evaluation and paid outcome readback remain separate.
